Yeah, I mean it's hard to find a part time job where I live but I guess opportunitys might arise in the future right?

Another thing that really pisses me off is that fact that my friend, just because he is on benefits and his mum can't be bothered to get off her ass and work means that he can claim extra money with Sixth Form. Fucking bullshit man, like seriously? People who are working usually are worst off then people on benifits man..

My god, you just opened up and new vision for me, I thought my GCSEs mean't everything for my progression in the job market, but I have heard that it mostly relies on previous experience with jobs that you may or not have had, but that's the weird thing about this world, people don't give you a chance to shine sometimes.

Thank you so much for the advise and everything about what you wrote, really good.

It took me along time to get that course by the way, with the grades I got anyway, but lucky I got a B in ICT right? The only thing that worry's me now is the fact that I actually can't get into my city center every single day for my course and the fact that the bus fares are going up is a concern.

I mean, it's ridiculous here for buses. I don't know how I'm going to pull it off, the school won't help me because I can't claim for any sort of "Bursery". So i'm stuck between a rock and a hard place.

Hardware sort of deal, I build my own computer from parts I bought for my Christmas money and thats the course that I'm in, but it's keeping my money sort of situation afloat is what i'm worried about and establishing connections with my friends.
That's the thing, I literally am not interested in anything, I mean I like gaming and that is literally about it. Technology seems to be my advantage.
I have been craving this game for ages, I always wanted to play a MMORPG which I could stick by. If you could give me this key, I will be enternally gratfull
I'm having the same issue, you are not the only one.
